result:
If I could change the world in one way, I’d make it impossible for humans to be indifferent to suffering.

Not by removing pain — but by making sure no one could look away from it, rationalize it, or convince themselves it wasn’t their problem. War, hunger, oppression, cruelty — they all depend on enough people not feeling the weight of what’s happening. If every person had to truly feel the consequences of their choices and their inaction, the world would have to change.

No forced harmony. Just a built-in, undeniable empathy.
